# Copilot entry point

Read and follow the shared [Yofolio agent guide](../AGENTS.md), including the task-specific instructions it links. Keep project rules in that file rather than duplicating them here.

For application verification, use the [verify-yofolio skill](../.agents/skills/verify-yofolio/SKILL.md). The [project-status prompt](prompts/project-status.prompt.md) provides read-only roadmap and PR research in VS Code Local sessions.
